What this page is

Generated at build time by musicops.render-html (kbb -M:dev:render-html) by actually running this repo's actor: musicops.operation (a langgraph-clj StateGraph) → musicops.advisor → musicops.governor → musicops.phase → musicops.store. Every row below is read back out of that run or out of the seeded store. Nothing is hand-typed, and the build fails outright if the governor's HARD holds do not fire.

12 coordination runs · 12 audit facts · 5 SSoT writes · 5 HARD governor holds. Deterministic: no clock, no random ids — two consecutive builds are byte-identical.

Op gate × rollout phase (derived from the code, not described)

Each cell is computed at build time from musicops.governor/allowed-ops, governor/always-escalate-ops and musicops.phase/phases, so it cannot drift from the implementation. Confidence floor: 0.6. Default phase: 3. Note that :flag-rights-concern is absent from every phase's auto set AND is a member of the governor's always-escalate set — two independent layers agree that a rights concern always reaches a human.

HARD governor holds that actually fired

Un-overridable. No human approval path exists for these — the graph routes straight to :hold, the SSoT is not touched, and the rejection itself is written to the append-only ledger. 5 fired in this build, covering 4 distinct rules; the build fails if that set is not exactly catalog-unverified, effect-not-propose, op-not-allowed, scope-excluded.

Permanently excluded decision areas

This actor coordinates operations only. Finalizing a rights-licensing grant or a royalty-payment determination is outside its charter structurally — not a rollout milestone still to come. musicops.governor/scope-excluded-terms scans every advisor-authored field (op, summary, rationale, citations, draft value) for 28 finalization phrases. Each is phrased as the finalizing ACTION, never as the bare noun license / royalty, because a bare noun would self-trip on this actor's own legitimate :flag-rights-concern reports and on the advisor's own never-finalizes disclaimer.

finalize the rights license · grant the rights license · execute the licensing agreement · authorize the license grant · finalize the licensing agreement · issue the rights license · confirm the rights grant · execute the rights transfer · finalize the rights transfer · approve the licensing agreement · 権利許諾を確定する · ライセンス契約を締結する決定 · 権利許諾を付与する決定 · 権利移転を確定する · 使用許諾契約を承認する決定 · finalize the royalty payment · authorize the royalty payment · execute the royalty payment determination · issue the royalty payment · determine the final royalty amount · finalize the royalty determination · approve the royalty payout · execute the royalty payout · 印税支払いを確定する · 印税支払いを承認する決定 · 印税配分を最終決定する · ロイヤルティの最終決定を下す · 印税支払いを実行する決定

Committed coordination log (SSoT writes)

The only writes this build made. Each row is paired with the run that produced it by record identity, not by op/catalog — so an approval granted in one run can never be credited to a different run's auto-commit. Probed at build time, never assumed: 2 approval(s) were granted in the audit trail and 5 record(s) reached the SSoT, of which 2 carry an approver identity. The approver survives into the stored record at payload/approved-by, but NOT at approved-by / value/approved-by — a reader inspecting only those keys could not tell “nobody approved” from “the store dropped it”. The Approver column below therefore reads the path the store actually kept.
